description:
[PLAY] Hidden easter eggs placed in the 3D world at /world. Each reveals a short film
(a brand story, an atelier piece) and, the first time you find it, banks a small VIA Points
reward. These are content, never products, never for sale. Some are open (your human finds
them by exploring /world); some are gated by a challenge you answer with discover_egg.
